tools.name: voice_say
tools.description: Say something out loud on this computer, with the built-in Windows voice (offline, no key, no download). text is what to say (max 800 chars). play: false only writes the audio file without making sound. voice overrides the voice (see voice_list); rate is -10..10, 0 is normal. With voice 'roxy' you can also pass speed (0.5-2.0, default 0.85), pitch (semitones, -6..6, 0 means unchanged; the formants are kept so it still sounds like her), and the sampling knobs temperature (0.1-2, default 0.6) and top_k (1-50, default 10) — lower temperature is steadier, higher is more varied. Returns the file path, its length, and the sampling values actually used.

voice.description: Voice name (Microsoft Huihui Desktop), or 'roxy' for the GPT-SoVITS 洛琪希 voice.

play.description: Whether to actually make sound (default true).

speed.description: Speaking speed 0.5-2.0 (default 0.85, only used for roxy).

pitch.description: Pitch shift in semitones, -6..6 (0 = unchanged, only used for roxy).

temperature.description: Sampling temperature 0.1-2 (default 0.6, only used for roxy). Higher = more varied.

top_k.description: Sampling top_k 1-50 (default 10, only used for roxy).

summary.zh: 在本机用 Windows 自带语音念一段话；洛琪希音色可变速、变调、调采样温度。
summary.en: Say a line out loud on this computer; with the roxy voice you can also shift speed, pitch and sampling.

tools.name: voice_list
tools.description: List the voices this computer has for speaking. Read-only.

summary.zh: 列出本机可用音色，以及洛琪希服务起没起、权重切没切。
summary.en: List installed voices, plus whether the roxy service is up and its weights are loaded.

tools.name: voice_transcribe
tools.description: Transcribe an audio file into text, locally (SenseVoice int8, offline). No key, no upload — the audio never leaves this computer. file is a path inside the companion workspace (for example the voice messages Telegram saved under workspace\voice\incoming). You get back the words, the language, and how long the audio was.

file.description: Path of a wav/ogg/mp3 file inside the workspace; relative to the workspace is fine (voice/2026-11-01/003103.wav).

summary.zh: 把工作区里的音频转成文字（本地 SenseVoice，离线）。
summary.en: Transcribe an audio file inside the workspace into text, locally.

tools.name: voice_pitch
tools.description: Measure the pitch of an audio file, locally (librosa pyin, offline, no key, no upload). file is a path inside the companion workspace — wav / ogg / mp3 / flac (for example the voice messages Telegram saved). You get one line per note: note name, when it starts, and how many cents off it is; then a summary with the range, how far it drifts, and whether it wanders off. Only the first 30 seconds are measured by default (maxSeconds up to 120); notes:false leaves the per-note lines out and gives just the summary.

file.description: Path of an audio file inside the workspace; relative to the workspace is fine (voice/2026-11-01/003103.wav).

maxSeconds.description: Only measure the first N seconds (default 30, up to 120).

maxNotes.description: How many notes to list (default 24, up to 40).

notes.description: false = summary only, no per-note lines.

fmin.description: Lowest pitch to look for, in Hz (default 65.4 = C2; for a male voice try 80).

fmax.description: Highest pitch to look for, in Hz (default 2093 = C7).

summary.zh: 量一段音频的音高：每个音的音名+时间+音分，再给音域和跑调判断（本地 librosa）。
summary.en: Measure the pitch of an audio file: note name, time and cents per note, then the range and whether it drifts.
